audit_items.proof_trace: Both anon-key clients (createSupabaseServerClient via @supabase/ssr createServerClient, and createSupabaseBrowserClient via createBrowserClient) use NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY with cookie-based JWT forwarding; Supabase platform enforces RLS against the user's session claims for all queries. The RLS-bypassing createSupabaseAdminClient uses a separate SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and is definitionally not the anon client — the property assertion ('forall query via anon_client') does not cover it.
